snippet.title: Earthscaper Official Trailer 🏗️🌍 Request VIP Access via Discord & get a #Berlin Creator Pack!
snippet.description:
Earthscaper is a social-building MMO which invites players to reshape the world together. Based on a  stylized version of the real world, players can work together to discover new map locations, rebuild cities, redesign famous landmarks, decorate bases, and create challenging minigames for one another to compete in.

🎟️ Join our Discord now to request VIP Access: https://discord.com/invite/az7bCEF8NF

🎁 Wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2909760/Earthscaper/
